newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to supply funds to ease liquidity shortage.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to supply funds to ease liquidity shortage.

text.p: South Korea plans to supply 2.0-2.5 trillion won to the money market in early February to ease tight liquidity caused by the Hanbo Group's financial crisis and strong cash demand prior to the Lunar New Year holidays, the Ministry of Finance and Economy said on Wednesday.
The ministry said in a statement it also planned to provide another 570 billion won during January and February to Hanbo Steel Co suppliers and subcontractors
The ministry said it would control the money supply growth more flexibly in an effort to stabilise interest rates and financial markets.
It said a total of 3.6 trillion won had been pumped into the money market since last Friday.
Hanbo Steel, the flagship of the Hanbo Group, defaulted on debt repayments last week and has applied for court protection on Tuesday along with its affiliate Hanbo Corp.
